items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: they had Hugo Winterhalter and me, and before that it had been Bill. That lasted about three weeks

ctx.x: Yes. Bill had just been drafted and Tommy idolized Bill. I don't know how I came to go, but they needed-- they had Hugo Winterhalter and me, and before that it had been Bill. That lasted about three weeks; he didn't like what I did at all.
He was kind of an abrasive character, wasn't he?
